evidence.summary: The regulator said it will open a formal review of grid reliability standards after two utilities reported near-miss outages during last week's heat wave.
evidence.title: Grid regulator to review reliability standards

evidence.summary: Two regional transit agencies confirmed a pilot to share one maintenance depot, saying it should reduce vehicle downtime; a joint report is due in December.
evidence.title: Transit agencies to share a maintenance depot

evidence.summary: A second transit agency confirmed it joined the shared maintenance depot pilot announced earlier this week.
evidence.title: Second agency confirms shared depot pilot
